item.title: Spencer and Monique Tepe Autopsy Results | Vinnie Politan Investigates
item.description: Vinnie Politan analyzes the autopsy results of Spencer Tepe and Monique Tepe and discusses the arrest of Monique’s ex-husband, Michael McKee. (2/03/26)

item.title: Sheriff: No Person Of Interest Yet In Nancy Guthrie’s Disappearance
item.description: Investigators say they have no suspects identified yet after images show what appears to be blood outside the home of Nancy Guthrie. The mother of 'Today' anchor Savannah Guthrie was reported missing on Sunday. (2/4/26)

item.title: Teen Austin Thompson’s Killing Spree: Court Hears 911 Call
item.description: The court hears a 911 call made by Nathan Spiegel, a bicycle rider who saw a victim along a trail during a shooting spree that left five people dead and two injured. Austin Thompson was 15 when he went on a rampage in his neighborhood. (2/3/26)

item.title: Defendant’s Cousin Testifies to Finding Michelle Long, Calling 911
item.description: Robert Morris testified about finding Michelle Long shot to death in her truck and calling 911. Michelle's ex-husband, William Long, is standing trial for her death. (2/4/26)

item.title: Melodee Buzzard’s belongings removed from home ahead of memorial
item.description: VANDENBERG VILLAGE, Calif. (Scripps News Group) — A judge has determined that one of 9-year-old Melodee Buzzard‘s half-sisters will be responsible for decisions surrounding her remains, as memorial items continue to accumulate outside the Vandenberg Village home where she lived. Melodee was found shot to death in a rural area of Utah on Dec. 6,... Read more »

item.title: ‘I’ll Talk to You Tomorrow’: Friend Recalls Last Call With Tara Baker
item.description: Tara Baker’s close friend recalls their first day of law school, late-night studying, and the last phone call they ever shared. (2/3/26)

item.title: Defendant Paul Caneiro Wipes Away Tears During Nephew’s Autopsy Report
item.description: Defendant Paul Caneiro displayed a rare moment of emotion in court as he wipes away tears as the medical examiner goes over the autopsy report of his nephew, Jesse. Caneiro is accused of killing his brother and his family, including his nephew. (2/4/26)

item.title: ‘They Were Really Good Kids’: Austin and James Thompson’s Mother Testifies
item.description: Elise Thompson said she found her son, James, dead on the bathroom floor before realizing Austin was the gunman. (2/4/26)

item.title: ‘Worse Than Communist Russia’; Defense Seeks Mistrial in Tara Baker Murder Trial
item.description: Tiffany Schroeder testifies about a man she saw walking in the neighborhood after Tara Baker’s 2001 death. Defense attorney Ahmad Crews moves for a mistrial, arguing the trial process has been worse than communist Russia. (2/03/26)

item.title: Wisconsin Kayaker Who Faked Death No-Shows In Court
item.description: Ryan Borgwardt missed a court hearing meant to discuss a motion he filed seeking to delete evidence in his case. Borgwardt faked his death in Aug. 2024 by flipping his kayak in a Wisconsin lake. (2/4/26)
